scripts.dev: concurrently -n emulators,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:emulators" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:emulators: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --export-on-exit=./.firebase-emulator-data
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @nbbl/shared && npm run regenerate-seed-stats -w functions && npm run seed -w functions
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nbbl/shared && npm run build -w @nbbl/server && npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w @nbbl/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nbbl/shared && npm run test -w functions
